hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; if echo "$f" | grep -qE '\.go$'; then if ! bash scripts/check-telemetry.sh 2>&1; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"TELEMETRY CHECK FAILED: One or more Go files with context.Context functions are missing OpenTelemetry instrumentation. See CLAUDE.md Observability (MANDATORY) section. You MUST add telemetry spans and use slog.*Context() before proceeding."}}'; fi; fi; }
